skills.name: Idempotency
skills.description: The same request sent twice has the effect of sending it once (retries, double clicks, replays).

skills.name: Tenant isolation
skills.description: One customer can never read or change another customer's data.

skills.name: Pagination
skills.description: Lists split into pages return every item exactly once, in a stable order.

skills.name: Money invariants
skills.description: Amounts add up: no refund beyond what was paid, no rounding drift, integer minor units.

skills.name: State machines
skills.description: Objects move only through allowed states (pending, succeeded, refunded...).

skills.name: Retries & timeouts
skills.description: Calls to other systems give up in time and retry without making things worse.

skills.name: Race conditions
skills.description: Two things happening at once cannot break a rule that holds when they happen one at a time.

skills.name: Caching
skills.description: Cached data is fresh enough, evicted correctly and does not stampede the source.

skills.name: Input validation
skills.description: Bad, missing or extreme input is rejected or handled instead of trusted.

skills.name: Backward compatibility
skills.description: Existing callers keep working when the code or the API changes.

skills.name: Memory safety
skills.description: No use-after-free, overflow or read of memory the code does not own.

skills.name: Resource management
skills.description: Everything acquired is released once, on every path including errors.

skills.name: Integer arithmetic
skills.description: Division, overflow, sign and truncation behave as intended.
